annotations.title: Medicine check: FDA label, recalls, shortages

description: Official facts about a medicine from its brand or generic name (e.g. 'Advil', 'metformin'). In the EU and EEA (send the country): the European Medicines Agency's authorisation, what it's approved for, shortages and safety letters to doctors. In the US: whether it's over the counter or prescription, what the FDA label says it's for, its boxed warning and key warnings, a link to the full label (DailyMed), FDA recall reports, current FDA drug shortages, and what US pharmacies pay per tablet for each strength (CMS NADAC), brand next to generic. With `with` set to a second medicine, returns the exact label sentences where either label names the other. Use for questions about a medicine, its recalls, availability or cost, or a combination someone takes. Not medical advice; absence of a mention is not a sign of safety. Not for foods (use check_food) or medical devices (use check_recalls).

country.description: Where the person lives; an EU or EEA country uses the European Medicines Agency instead of the FDA

name.description: Brand or generic name, e.g. 'Advil' or 'metformin'

with.description: A second medicine the person takes, to look for in both labels

name: check_medicine
